law_record.title: When lighted lamps are required (1)
law_record.text: Every vehicle upon a highway of this State, subject to exceptions with respect to parked vehicles as stated in chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, must display lighted lamps and illuminating devices as respectively required in this chapter for different classes of vehicles: (a) At any time from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise; (b) At any other time when, because of insufficient light or unfavorable atmospheric conditions, persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearly discernible at a distance of 1,000 feet ahead; and (c) When directed by an official traffic control device.

activation_conditions: the subject is a vehicle upon a highway
the time is from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise, or persons and vehicles are not clearly discernible at 1,000 feet, or an official device so directs
exceptions: the exceptions for parked vehicles stated elsewhere in the traffic chapters
residue: the 1,000-foot discernibility test is a visibility measurement the source may not provide; a rule reading only drv.civil_night covers branch (a) alone
